answer: Private set intersection screening: each epoch every agent commits a salted MinHash sketch of the sources its answer actually drew on, spot-checked against the cited text. A lantern service runs PSI-cardinality on random pairs, learning only how much two sketches overlap, never the sources. Independent agents share a sliver; a farm fed from one hollow corpus overlaps almost fully, so pairs above a threshold are folded into one reward haven and split a single share.
